scene: Inside the mansion's transit hub, three departures hum with energy.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left waits a sleek hover metro. Beside it stands the grandmother in her pink tracksuit and round glasses, leash in hand beside her white dog. At the centre sits a parked winged flying scooter. On the far right idles a red double-decker hover bus beside a terminal sign.
